title: Subject-Relative Micro-Motion and Sleep Dynamics for Near-Infrared Video Sleep Staging
abstract: arXiv:2609.05550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Near-infrared (NIR) video is a promising modality for contactless sleep monitoring, but recent video-based sleep staging methods often use it as a route to reconstructed respiratory/cardiac proxies or cross-modal physiological representations. We study video-only sleep staging under labels defined by polysomnography (PSG), where the model infers sleep stages from NIR video alone without explicit physiological proxy reconstruction or auxiliary physiological signal supervision. This tests whether NIR video itself can provide informative sleep-stage evidence, rather than only serving as an input for recovering physiological proxies. We propose ViNUSS (Video-Native Unmediated Sleep Staging), a framework that combines subject-relative micro-motion learning with full-night sleep dynamics modeling. translated_title: 基于受试者相对微运动与睡眠动态建模的近红外视频睡眠分期
translated_abstract: 近红外（NIR）视频是一种很有前景的非接触式睡眠监测模态，但近期的基于视频的睡眠分期方法往往将其作为重建呼吸/心脏替代信号或跨模态生理表征的途径。我们研究了在多导睡眠图（PSG）定义的标签下进行纯视频睡眠分期，即模型仅依靠NIR视频来推断睡眠阶段，而无需显式的生理替代信号重建或辅助生理信号监督。这检验了NIR视频本身是否能提供有信息量的睡眠阶段证据，而不仅仅是作为恢复生理替代信号的输入。我们提出了ViNUSS（Video-Native Unmediated Sleep Staging，视频原生无中介睡眠分期）框架，该框架将受试者相对微运动学习与整晚睡眠动态建模相结合。空间锚定的前置空间微运动编码在保留局部时间变化的同时保留其空间上下文。受试者内的睡眠阶段……
tldr: 提出ViNUSS框架，无需重建任何生理替代信号，仅利用近红外视频本身，通过受试者相对微运动学习与整晚睡眠动态建模，依据PSG标签实现纯视频睡眠分期。
en_tdlr: Proposes ViNUSS, a framework that achieves video-only sleep staging from NIR video based on PSG labels—without reconstructing physiological proxies—by combining subject-relative micro-motion learning with full-night sleep dynamics modeling.
